name: Make detection triage evidenced and time-bounded
description: Give detections a named responder, a committed triage timeframe, and a recorded disposition with its basis, so the acting element of the control produces evidence rather than only the detecting element.

steps.action: Define severity levels for detections and a triage timeframe for each, set from measured capacity rather than aspiration.
Assign a named responder or on-call rotation, so responsibility is attributable rather than collective.
Require a recorded disposition with its basis for every detection, replacing bare status changes.
Where auto-closure rules are used, document each rule and its rationale so suppression is informed rather than silent.
Measure elapsed time from detection to triage against the committed timeframe and report on it.
Define the escalation threshold at which a detection becomes an incident, and link the two records.
Export the unfiltered detection population for evidence, not only closed or true-positive items.

implementation_considerations: Setting an aggressive triage timeframe manufactures its own exceptions. Measure current performance first and commit to something achievable.
Requiring a written basis on every low-severity detection will be abandoned under volume. Tune detection quality and document suppression rules rather than demanding prose per alert.
Where triage genuinely happens in an incident or ticketing system, the fix may be reconciling the two records rather than changing any behaviour.
An unfiltered export is uncomfortable because it reveals the backlog. That visibility is the point, and it is better found internally than in fieldwork.
typical_duration: Weeks to implement; one period to accumulate the evidence.
prerequisites: A detection platform capable of exporting the full population
An agreed on-call or responder model

verification_method.how: Export the unfiltered detection population for a completed interval and confirm each item has a responder, a disposition with a basis, and a triage time measurable against the committed timeframe.

residual_risk_note: Evidenced triage demonstrates that alerts were assessed, not that the assessments were correct. Detection tuning quality remains outside what this record proves.
period_limitation_note: Triage records cannot be created after the fact. Where detections during an elapsed period have no disposition, the evidence gap for that period stands and this remediation addresses recurrence only.
notes: This addresses an insufficient-evidence observation. Triage may well have been occurring; what is being remediated is that it left no record.
